explication: Captura is a Windows desktop screen recorder and screenshot tool, with a command-line entry point. The main workflow selects screen, window, region, webcam, and audio inputs; captures and overlays frames; then records or saves screenshots as files or uploads. The tree documents additional AVI/GIF/MP4, replay, steps, hotkey, and localization capabilities. Sampled source confirms CLI recording and screenshot calls, Windows capture providers, preview handling, and FFmpeg process/log behavior; other subsystem links reflect documented capabilities and tree structure.
